description: File a note in a folder, or take it out of every folder. Changes nothing inside the note. Password-locked notes cannot be moved from here.

folder_id.description: The folder to put the note in, as returned by list_folders. Omit it to take the note out of every folder, into Uncategorized.

note_id.description: Note id, as returned by search_notes or list_notes.

name: scratchpad_move_note
title: Move note
